name: Parts and Pieces

angles.text: Tinkerers and engineers can appreciate the irony of a sophisticated mechanical contraption falling victim to crude piracy. Salvaging Wrenix's complicated parts offers a firsthand reminder of the dangers of deploying automated prototypes into hostile camps without proper physical safeguards.

faq.answer: Wrenix the Wretched is an eccentric tinkerer residing in the neutral port town of Ratchet. Facing an aggressive crew of marauders along the coast to the south, Wrenix attempted to resolve the pirate issue through technological innovation. After several hired mercenaries failed to survive their missions, he built and dispatched an automated machine to handle the threat, only to have it swiftly dismantled.

aliases: what happened to the other adventurers
faq.answer: Before resorting to mechanical automation, Wrenix hired five or six different adventurers to eliminate the pirate threat south of Ratchet. Not a single one of those operatives returned alive, proving how lethal and well-defended the pirate camps truly are. Their grim demise prompted Wrenix to conclude that relying on flesh-and-blood mercenaries was both inefficient and fatal.
faq.q: What happened to the earlier mercenaries Wrenix hired?

aliases: why did wrenix use a contraption
faq.answer: Wrenix constructed and dispatched a mechanical device because his previous attempts using living mercenaries had resulted in total failure and loss of life. Believing that a clockwork creation could succeed where mortal fighters fell—or at least avoid further casualties—he sent the machine directly into the encampment, expecting mechanical ingenuity to overcome the pirates.
faq.q: Why did Wrenix send a machine to fight the pirates?

aliases: how did pirates dismantle the robot
faq.answer: The pirates proved surprisingly inventive when confronted with Wrenix's construct. Using their curved scimitars as makeshift screwdrivers, the raiders rapidly pried the machine apart before Wrenix could transmit commands redirecting it back toward Ratchet. They dismantled the contraption down to its frame and scattered its intricate components all across their encampment.
faq.q: How did the pirates dismantle Wrenix's machine?

faq.answer: The components of Wrenix's shattered machine are located within the upper pirate camp situated along the coastline south of Ratchet. After stripping the device with their scimitars, the pirates left its intricate pieces scattered on the ground throughout their hilltop camp. Adventurers must slip into the camp and collect five handfuls of these complicated parts.
faq.q: Where are the complicated parts located?

aliases: why does wrenix think you will survive
faq.answer: Wrenix believes this assignment offers far better odds of survival because it is purely a salvage operation rather than an open assault. The previous mercenaries were instructed to eradicate the pirate presence directly, whereas this retrieval mission simply requires slipping into the upper encampment, gathering five handfuls of scattered machine components from the dirt, and returning to Ratchet.
faq.q: Why does Wrenix believe this retrieval mission is safer?

aliases: why does wrenix need the parts
what does wrenix do with the parts
faq.answer: The complicated parts are the specialized gears, springs, and precision mechanical fittings that powered Wrenix's automated construct. Because his attempt to neutralize the pirate problem ended in the machine being taken apart, Wrenix needs these delicate pieces retrieved so his valuable engineering craftsmanship and materials do not go entirely to waste.
faq.q: What are the Complicated Parts needed for?

sections.body: Pirate activity along the coast south of Ratchet has grown increasingly troublesome for the port's residents and tradesfolk. Seeking to handle the marauders without risking any more coin on expendable hired hands, the tinkerer Wrenix the Wretched took matters into his own hands. After sending five or six mercenaries who all failed to return alive, Wrenix devised what seemed like an inspired alternative: sending an automated machine to deal with the raiders. Rather than putting another living soul at risk, the mechanical construct was dispatched to resolve the encampment problem autonomously.
sections.title: A Mechanical Solution

sections.body: The inventive deployment did not go as smoothly as planned. The pirates occupying the encampments south of town proved surprisingly resourceful with their blades, quickly discovering that curved scimitars could double as makeshift screwdrivers. Before Wrenix could send instructions directing the machine to retreat back toward Ratchet, the marauders pried the mechanism apart and scattered its delicate components all over their upper camp. Now, instead of eliminating the pirate presence, the inventor requires a daring scout to slip into the encampment and gather up five handfuls of the complicated mechanical parts left behind in the dirt.
sections.title: Scimitars and Screwdrivers

summary: Parts and Pieces is a retrieval quest offered by Wrenix the Wretched in the port town of Ratchet. After several mercenaries failed to survive encounters with the local pirates, Wrenix deployed a mechanical contraption to handle the threat, only for the raiders to dismantle it into scrap. Adventurers are tasked with heading to the pirates' upper camp to recover the scattered machinery before further harm is done.
